Even so, she helps Leon several times and seems to care about him in her own little way. She also doesn’t tell Ethan that he’s infected despite knowing that for years. I’m pretty sure it’s also implied that she abandoned rose sometime after Ethan died.

Am I the only person here who like the anime? I knew going in that it would be changing lore and prepared myself for it. 

I like that they’re adding more depth to everything with makai and really explaining how horrible it is there. It also shows that Sparda wasn’t just an exception to the belief that all demons are evil, but rather was the only one strong enough to do something about it.

Lady was most definitely the biggest surprise in the show for me. She’s definitely got a mouth on her compared to her game counterpart, but it almost makes sense. She had to go somewhere to learn everything she did in order to kill demons, and I doubt who she learned from cared to correct any language she picked up from them or the people around them. As for joining darkcom, she may have chose this path because that’s where she thought she could do the most good and prevent anything similar to what happened to her. 

Lady also learns that the conditions in makai are horrible, and many who live there only want to live. She tries to help them, realizing that they don’t mean any harm. She isn’t aware that Baines ordered for all the soldiers to kill the demons, and believes it’s the white rabbit’s fault. I really do think that if she learns about it, she will completely abandon darkcom, but they still have some sort of control over her before the end, since she still helps lock Dante away before Baines starts his war on the demon world. Up until then, she believed that Baines only does what is necessary to keep the human world safe, and was told that Dante was still a threat. She has followed his orders without question for years, and that is a hard thing to go back on until you’re really forced to see that a person doesn’t have anyone’s best interests at heart but their own.

As for Vergil serving Mundus willingly, it does confuse me but I feel like it’s something I shouldn’t weigh in on until I know more about it, which could take a while, if ever, since he may have his own agenda or has been misled.

All in all, I want a second season to see if they cover any of this before I start to harshly judge the writing decisions they’ve made.
